topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I came across a post online today, someone had tattooed one of my digital pieces on their arm. At first, I started thinking about the implications—copyright and all that. But then, I saw the craftsmanship; they did an incredible job. It's flattering, really, to see my work resonate so deeply with someone that they'd want to carry it with them permanently. I decided to reach out to them, thank them for their appreciation, and perhaps have a conversation about art and its personal meanings. I might even share their tattoo on my page, giving them credit, of course. It seems like a positive way to turn a potentially tricky situation into a moment of connection.
